name: nightguard-monorepo
description: NightGuard - Wi-Fi-based Digital Wellbeing and Device Access Management
author: Panth Patel

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@nightguard/shared && npm run build --workspace=@nightguard/security && npm run generate --workspace=@nightguard/database && npm run build --workspace=@nightguard/database && npm run build --workspace=@nightguard/router-adapters && npm run build --workspace=@nightguard/scheduler
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@nightguard/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@nightguard/shared && npm run build --workspace=@nightguard/web
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=@nightguard/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@nightguard/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@nightguard/worker"
